messages:
Jessica: quick heads-up — starting perf sweep for peregrine-8b onboard today, need a couple quick checks before we run wide
Devin: thanks! where are the finalized weights?
Jessica: s3://rwinf-models/peregrine/8b/v1/weights-2026-03-14/*.pt (sha256 in the PR)
Arjun: got it. tokenizer note — there was a small mismatch with `sentencepiece.model` vs our catalog tokenizers, saw extra leading-space tokens on a handful of eval prompts
Mika: can you paste the failing example?
Arjun: yep — sample input "Hello world" tokenized as `[▁Hello, ▁world]` on the repo model but as `[Hello, world]` on the onboard artifact. looks like the `add_prefix_space` flag got flipped during conversion
Jessica: ugh — that would shift token counts. I'll re-run the conversion with `add_prefix_space=True` and upload new artifacts in ~20m
Sam: pinging code review — PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/342 , changed the tokenizer wrapper, added unit test for prefix space. @Olivia can you review when free? :pray:
Olivia: I'll take a look in ~30m. quick Q: what batch sizes are we targeting for the perf run?
Jessica: start with [1, 2, 4, 8, 16] and run continuous batching mode with seq-len 512 and 2048 profiles. primary metric: p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec
Devin: FYI config validator flagged `max_length` mismatch between catalog and model config — catalog had 4096 but model config 2048. Which should we trust?
Mika: model config is authoritative for now, but we should update catalog entry if we pin to 2048. PR to follow after onboard is green
Arjun: running smoke perf locally on a single A10G now, will push logs to the perf run folder when done
perf-bot: perf job queued: job_id=perf-2319876543-1, runner=eng-ml-smoke, profile=[512,2048], batches=[1,2,4,8,16]
Sam: note for the sweep — enable KV cache warmup for the 2048 runs, otherwise first-token latency will be noisy
Jessica: good call. also enabling prefix cache TTL=60s
Arjun: pasted quick-run output to s3://rwinf-perf/peregrine/8b/2319876543/smoke.log:
```
[INFO] seq=512 batch=4 p50=32.1ms p95=78.4ms tokens/s=10500
[INFO] seq=2048 batch=8 p50=142ms p95=310ms tokens/s=8600
[WARN] tokenization mismatch encountered on 3/200 inputs; flagged for re-tokenize
```
Jessica: looks sane. once Olivia merges the tokenizer PR I'll swap weights and kick the full cluster run tonight (canary then wide)
Olivia: quick review done — left one nit about a null char check but it's minor, approving now :white_check_mark:
Sam: when you start the canary please tag #eng-runtime and drop the canary run id, I'll watch the console
Jessica: will do — canary scheduled for 23:30 PT, run id perf-2319876543-canary. adding checklist: update catalog max_length -> 2048, upload corrected tokenizer artifact, merge PR 342, run canary, capture cost per token numbers
Devin: thanks — if canary looks good I can start batch-sizing sweep across dedicated nodes tomorrow morning
perf-bot: perf job completed: job_id=perf-2319876543-1, status=COMPLETED, artifacts=s3://rwinf-perf/peregrine/8b/2319876543/smoke-results.json
Jessica: perfect, I'll grab the artifacts and post a findings summary in #eng-ml tomorrow morning :eyes:
